reviewer.model_metadata_source: Inherited parent session metadata reported by coordinator; no model override.

findings: ai_e2_full_freeze.py verifies every pre-authoring source/input digest, reference source_hashes/final_hashes, compatibility status and locked inference-sheet hash before assembling the reference-free bundle.

The release contains only the approved model/options/timeout/source/question/freeze metadata and denied-read probe path strings. Private reference contents, labels, slot plans and ranking data are not copied into the six-file bundle.
The full-freeze file map pins source/input evidence, reference custody and reviewable wrappers before opening. An existing global opening marker or existing bundle prevents silent refreezing.

ai_e2_references.py locks original label/receipt bytes before decoding/comparing labels, validates complete independent annotation receipts and strict rubric schema, retains original byte snapshots and computes the specified agreement measures.

Disputes alone are released for separate adjudication; agreed/adjudicated labels are retained. Clarify or a mismatch to the already frozen subtype/category roles aborts the reference version without coercion or selective replacement.

ai_e2_score.py checks prediction status, 200 unique terminal backend/ID pairs, 200 exact journal pairs, exact question texts, required journal/prediction manifest membership and every listed evidence digest before loading protected references.

Scoring then verifies the full freeze and reference-question correspondence, reuses the unchanged evaluation functions/checkpoints and preserves failures and denominators. No new sampling, prompt, model, band or statistical choice was introduced in this review.
scope_and_remaining_gates: This is source-only consistency review, not a statement that actual annotation meanings, agreement values, provenance declarations or output arithmetic have been independently audited.
No fresh case, label, annotation receipt, agreement, dispute, reference-freeze or prediction artifact was opened for this review.
The assembled full-freeze/release metadata and byte-hash correspondence remain to be checked after custody finalization and before the model run, as the coordinator specified.
Reference-content and independent computational audits remain restricted to after immutable predictions and protected scoring; this review does not execute them.
Application file/network checks remain a trusted-code boundary, not an OS sandbox or hostile-host defense. Shared model-family and absence of human-ground-truth limitations remain in force.
